summary: Ephemeral privileged SSH access for new ML Infra hire + onboarding laptop pickup window policy clarification
description:
Background: New ML Infrastructure engineer (FT) starts 2026-02-15 and needs time-limited sudo/SSH access to the on-prem GPU staging cluster for bootstrapping internal tooling and completing secure-lab setup. HR has arranged a laptop checkout and same-day pickup from HQ IT, but the engineer will be remote for the first week.

Request: 1) Issue ephemeral privileged SSH (sudo/admin) for user 'maria.velasquez@redwood.ai' on cluster 'gpu-stage-01' for a window of 72 hours beginning 2026-02-15 09:00 PST, with automatic expiration and audit logging. 2) Confirm policy for IT-supplied laptop pickup window: can the employee pick up equipment within 14 calendar days and have temporary remote MFA onboarding completed first?

Impact: Delaying SSH access blocks the infra engineer from completing baseline infra hardening tasks and onboarding automation (~3 onboarding tasks). We prefer a temporary controlled access flow rather than breaking tickets for each small change.

Policy question: Does Redwood permit issuing ephemeral elevation exceeding 48 hours for new hires when work requires it, provided access is time-bound, recorded in audit logs, and approved by manager + security? If not, what formal escalation/product request do we use?

Desired by: 2026-02-15 morning so first-day onboarding sessions are productive.
steps_to_complete: Manager (Dylan Park) approves ephemeral access by replying in ticket
SRE/Access team creates timed IAM role for 'mvelasquez' with SSH key and sudo policy set to expire 2026-02-18 09:00 PST
Add entry to ephemeral access log and link to PagerDuty/Slack channel for oversight
IT schedules laptop pickup and confirms remote MFA flow (Duo) is completed before first remote engagement
Security owner (Priya Rao) reviews and signs off on deviation if >48h is granted
investigation_notes:
Checked existing privileged access playbook: playbook supports timeboxed roles via 'ephem-access' service but default max duration is 48h. There is an open RFC to extend to 7 days for contractor flows (RFC-2025-privext) but not approved for FT hires. Audit logs can be produced from the vault and SSH bastion for requested window. No blocking SSO/SCIM issues discovered.

Ops check: gpu-stage-01 accepts SSH keys issued via internal CA; we can generate a short-lived certificate for the user scoped to the node group and sudoers file. Need explicit manager + security approval in ticket body for >48h windows.
comments: 2026-02-10 11:02 - Dylan Park (manager): Approving ephemeral access up to 72h for Maria to finish initial setup. Will be available on Slack for coordination.
2026-02-10 14:18 - Taylor Nguyen (SRE): Noted. Access-management can provision 72h cert but security MUST sign off. Submitted pre-approval request to Priya Rao.

2026-02-11 09:05 - Priya Rao (Security): For FT hires we prefer 48h as baseline. Exception approved for this case to 72h provided the following controls are in place: session recording enabled, sudo actions require explicit MFA, and the user is restricted to namespace 'onboard-maria'. I'll sign the exception once logs configuration is confirmed.

2026-02-11 10:32 - IT Support (Jenna Clarke): Laptop reserve created (serial SN-RED-1192). Employee can pick up within 10 business days from HQ front desk with ID and pickup code. Confirm if shipping is required instead.

2026-02-11 11:00 - Aisha Patel (reporter): Maria is remote first week; please ship laptop standard overnight to 1234 Elm St, Apt 6, San Francisco, CA 94107 if shipping is an approved option. Manager okayed shipping.
resolution: Provisioned: SRE issued short-lived SSH cert for 'mvelasquez' expiring 2026-02-18 09:00 PST scoped to 'onboard-maria' namespace. Session recording and sudo MFA enabled. IT shipped laptop via overnight to employee address; tracking #TRK-88441. Security exception documented in exception registry and linked in Confluence. Follow-up: update privileged access playbook to include a formal exception path for FT hires (ACTION: INT-16020).
follow_up_actions: INT-16020 - Create/update playbook for FT hire privileged-exception path
Add automated alert to #sre-ops when ephemeral access >48h is granted
Confirm delivery and onboarding completion with manager by 2026-02-20
